title: Business Support Administrator
description:
Business Support Administrator - Manchester (M1)
Company and Role Overview

V7 Recruitment is a Manchester-based recruitment agency specialising in Engineering and Technical industries across the UK and Europe.

We have grown quickly by challenging how recruitment has traditionally been done, and we need someone equally driven to help keep that growth moving.
This is not a background administrative role where every day looks the same.

As a Team Administrator, you will sit at the centre of a fast-moving recruitment business, coordinating international travel, managing assignment documentation, resolving candidate queries and ensuring the details behind every placement are handled properly.

You will work closely with our Senior Leadership Team, consultants, candidates and internal departments, often becoming the person people rely on when something needs organising, answering or fixing.

The role would suit someone who enjoys responsibility, communicates confidently and takes pride in staying one step ahead.

Key Responsibilities
- Travel and Accommodation Coordination: Organise flights, accommodation and travel arrangements for candidates working across the UK and Europe, responding quickly when plans change.
- Assignment Administration: Coordinate assignment schedules and documentation, ensuring candidates and internal teams have the correct information at the right time.
- Contract Support: Assist with contracts and act as a point of contact for contract-related questions.
- Payroll and Expense Queries: Support candidates with payroll and expense queries, working with the relevant internal teams to resolve issues accurately and efficiently.
- Tracking and Reporting: Maintain expense trackers, assignment records and administrative systems, ensuring information remains accurate and up to date.
- Candidate Support: Support candidates before and throughout their assignments, providing a reliable point of contact when they need guidance.
- Inbound Call Handling: Handle incoming calls with confidence and professionalism, resolving queries where possible or directing them to the right person.
- Senior Leadership Support: Provide responsive administrative support to the Senior Leadership Team and help ensure the wider business continues to run smoothly.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who does more than wait for the next task.
You will be proactive, organised and comfortable taking ownership in an environment where priorities can move quickly.

You will also have:
- Previous experience in an administrative, operations or business support role.
- Experience maintaining trackers, records and administrative systems.
- A confident and professional telephone manner.
- Strong organisational skills and close attention to detail.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills.
- The ability to prioritise competing tasks without losing sight of the detail.
- Confidence dealing with candidates and responding to contract, payroll and expense queries.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other administrative software.
- A practical, collaborative approach and the confidence to solve problems independently.
- Experience within recruitment or another fast-paced, service-led business would be beneficial, but attitude, organisation and ownership are just as important.

Why Join V7?
- You will be joining an ambitious business where good ideas are listened to, responsibility is encouraged and people are trusted to make an impact.
- This is an opportunity to take ownership of a varied role, work closely with senior leaders and become a key part of how V7 operates as the business continues to grow.

Working Conditions
- This position is based in our Manchester office.
- Working hours are 08:30-17:30 Monday to Thursday and 08:30-16:00 on Friday, with the option to work from home on Wednesday.

How to Apply

Ready to take ownership of a role where your work genuinely keeps the business moving?

Please submit your CV to (url removed).

V7 Recruitment is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.
V7 Recruitment is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the grounds of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation. All applications will be considered solely on merit and suitability for the role.
Please note that by applying for this position you are giving consent for V7 Recruitment to process and store your personal data in line with our Privacy Policy. We may contact you about this and other suitable opportunities. You can request your data to be removed at any time by contacting us.

title: Credit Hire Claims Handler
description:
Credit Hire Claims Handler

Manchester City Centre Office Based
Monday to Friday 08:30am - 5:00pm
£28,000 - £35,000 DOE

MPJ Recruitment are delighted to be working with a well-established and expanding insurance organisation who are looking to strengthen their claims team with an experienced Credit Hire Claims Handler.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a background in Credit Hire who wants to join a professional, supportive environment where you can manage your own caseload, build on your existing technical knowledge and progress your career within the insurance sector.

If you're confident handling Credit Hire claims and enjoy working on cases where investigation, negotiation and commercial decision-making are key, this could be an excellent next move.

The Opportunity

Joining an established claims team, you will take responsibility for a portfolio of Credit Hire claims, managing cases from initial notification through to successful resolution.

You'll deal with a wide range of stakeholders including claimants, solicitors, insurers and accident management companies, using your knowledge and negotiation skills to achieve appropriate and commercially viable settlements.

Key Responsibilities
- Take ownership of a caseload of Credit Hire claims from notification through to settlement.
- Investigate claims and establish liability, indemnity and overall claim position.
- Assess the validity and reasonableness of Credit Hire claims.
- Negotiate settlements with solicitors, insurers and other third parties.
- Challenge areas including hire duration, rates, need and impecuniosity where appropriate.
- Review statements, invoices, hire agreements and other supporting documentation.
- Identify opportunities to control and minimise claims expenditure.
- Proactively manage disputed, complex and high-value claims.
- Maintain accurate and comprehensive claims records.
- Ensure claims are handled in accordance with internal procedures, industry standards and regulatory requirements.
- Recognise and escalate potential fraud or suspicious activity.
- Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
- Deliver a professional and efficient service throughout the claims journey.

About You

We're looking for someone who already has experience within Credit Hire claims and is comfortable managing their own caseload.

Ideally, you'll have:
- Previous experience handling Credit Hire claims.
- A solid understanding of Credit Hire processes and principles.
- Knowledge of liability, indemnity and claims investigation.
- Experience negotiating settlements and dealing with disputed claims.
- The ability to confidently challenge costs and identify opportunities for mitigation.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent organisation and time-management skills.
- A proactive and commercially aware approach.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a wider team.

Experience within insurance, claims, legal, credit hire or accident management environments would be highly beneficial!

What's On Offer
- £28,000 - £35,000 salary, depending on experience
- 33 days annual leave
- Fully paid training
- Regular salary reviews
- Company pension scheme
- Clear opportunities for career progression
- Company social events
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Modern Manchester City Centre offices

Interested?

If you're an experienced Credit Hire Claims Handler looking for a new challenge with a growing organisation that offers genuine opportunities to develop, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Ecommerce Executive
description:
Ecommerce Executive Online Retailer Greater Manchester Salary up to 33k

A fast-growing scale-up business is looking for an ambitious Ecommerce Executive to join its growing Sales & Marketing team. This is an opportunity for someone who is commercially curious, highly proactive and genuinely interested in how ecommerce can drive business growth.

The role is hands-on and detail focused, with responsibility across website merchandising, campaign execution, digital marketing and performance analysis. The business is looking for someone who wants to get stuck in, spot opportunities, solve problems and learn quickly in an environment where no two days are the same.

This could suit an early-career ecommerce or marketing professional with 1-3 years' experience, or an ambitious graduate with a relevant degree and a genuine passion for ecommerce and digital marketing.

The Ecommerce Executive will work closely with the Ecommerce Manager to deliver day-to-day ecommerce and digital marketing activity, ensuring campaigns are executed effectively, the website is continually optimised and performance insights are turned into action.

The role will have a strong commercial focus, with the successful individual expected to take ownership, challenge the status quo and continually look for ways to improve the customer journey and online performance.

Key Responsibilities
- Own and maintain the campaign planner, ensuring activity is accurately planned, communicated and delivered across relevant teams.
- Coordinate campaigns across email, website, homepage and social channels.
- Manage product listings and online merchandising, ensuring content is accurate, engaging and optimised for conversion.
- Support seasonal promotions, product launches and other key commercial campaigns.
- Work with creative and content teams to deliver effective website and marketing assets.
- Analyse campaign, website and customer performance, tracking key metrics including traffic, conversion, ROI, engagement and retention.
- Produce regular performance reporting and turn data into clear, actionable recommendations.
- Research competitor activity, market trends and customer behaviour to identify new opportunities for growth.
- Support CRM, email and customer loyalty initiatives, with a focus on increasing engagement and lifetime value.
- Work closely with Ecommerce, Buying, Customer Service, IT and Development teams to resolve issues and improve the customer experience.
- Manage relationships with relevant technology and service partners, including search, reviews, payments and customer support platforms.
- Identify opportunities to improve website performance, merchandising and the overall customer journey.
- Take ownership of projects and processes, documenting best practice and continually looking for more efficient ways of working.

What We're Looking For

The ideal Ecommerce Executive will be someone who combines commercial curiosity with exceptional attention to detail. Experience is important, but attitude, potential and a genuine desire to learn will be equally valued.

You will bring:
- Experience in ecommerce, digital marketing, online retail or a related discipline, or a relevant degree with strong evidence of interest in ecommerce.
- A proactive, self-motivated approach and the confidence to take ownership rather than wait to be asked.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand data, identify insights and turn them into action.
- Excellent organisation and the ability to manage multiple campaigns, projects and priorities.
- A genuine interest in ecommerce, customer experience and digital growth.
- A meticulous eye for detail, particularly when managing website content, campaigns and reporting.
- A collaborative approach and the confidence to work across different teams.
- Adaptability and a willingness to get involved across different areas of the business.
- A growth mindset and enthusiasm for learning new platforms, tools and ways of working.
- Strong commercial awareness and a desire to understand what drives revenue and customer value
- Experience with ecommerce platforms such as Magento or Shopify, CRM, SEO/SEM, A/B testing, analytics or digital marketing tools would be advantageous, but is not essential.

The Ecommerce Executive role is particularly suited to someone who is hungry to learn, commercially minded and comfortable working at pace. The successful individual will be someone who sees a problem and finds a solution, spots an opportunity and acts on it, and wants to build a career in ecommerce rather than simply do a job.

title: Lettings Administrator
description:
Resident Lettings Administrator / Resident Contracts Executive

Manchester City Centre £27,000 + £2,000 Bonus Monday-Friday

Looking to start a career in property?

If you're organised, hard-working and ambitious, and have a genuine interest in building a career within the property industry, this could be the opportunity you've been looking for.

We're recruiting for a global property group with a fantastic culture, exciting residential brands and an excellent reputation for developing its people.

This is an entry-level opportunity designed for someone who wants to learn, develop and build a long-term career within property.

Previous experience in property, lettings, estate agency or residential accommodation would certainly be beneficial - but it isn't essential.

What's more important is your genuine interest in property, your attitude and your ability to work in an organised, structured and accurate way.

The Opportunity

You'll join the team responsible for the administration behind the resident journey, helping ensure everything is in place from application through to move-in and throughout the tenancy.

It's a busy, admin-focused position where attention to detail is key. You'll work closely with Sales and Operations while learning about tenancy agreements, referencing, compliance, rental payments and the wider residential property operation.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Preparing tenancy agreements and licences
- Carrying out tenant referencing and Right to Rent checks
- Ensuring contracts, documentation and payments are completed before move-in
- Maintaining accurate resident, tenancy and CRM records
- Managing rent schedules and payment reconciliation
- Investigating payment queries and discrepancies
- Monitoring outstanding rental payments
- Supporting tenancy and debt management administration
- Liaising with residents, solicitors, councils and external partners
- Supporting the wider Sales and Operations teams

Who Are We Looking For?

You don't need years of experience. We're looking for someone with the right attitude and a genuine desire to develop a career in property.

You'll ideally be:
- Highly organised and structured in the way you work
- Hard-working, reliable and willing to learn
- Someone who enjoys an administration-based role
- Accurate with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable managing several tasks and deadlines
- Confident communicating with customers and colleagues
- Proactive and happy taking responsibility for your workload
- Genuinely interested in property and residential living
- Ambitious to learn, develop and progress

You could be a graduate or early-career professional, or perhaps you're already working within administration, customer service, finance, lettings or estate agency and want to establish yourself within the property industry.

Why This Opportunity?

This isn't just about finding your next admin job.

It's an opportunity to get your foot in the door of the property industry with a successful global organisation where you'll gain valuable experience, learn how a major residential property business operates and have the opportunity to develop your career as the company continues to grow.

You'll receive:
- £27,000 basic salary + £2,000 bonus opportunity
- Monday-Friday, 08:30-17:00
- 22 days holiday, increasing to 25 days with service
- Perkbox with 250+ discounts, perks and wellbeing benefits
- Excellent training and development
- Genuine opportunities for long-term career progression
- A fantastic working culture within a growing global property group

If you're organised, ambitious and serious about starting a career in property, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Operations Administrator
description:
Operations Administrator

Manchester 25,000 - 28,000 Hybrid working: 4 days office, 1 day from home

MFK Recruitment is delighted to be recruiting an Operations Administrator for a highly respected organisation based in Manchester.

We have recruited 7 people into the organisation over the past three and a half years, and all seven are still there. That speaks volumes about the culture, leadership, stability and quality of the working environment.

This is a great opportunity for someone with administration, operations or logistics experience who wants to join a supportive and well-established organisation where their work genuinely has an impact.

The Role

As Operations Administrator, you will provide administrative and operational support across a wide range of activities.

A key part of the role will involve supporting the planning and delivery of sample distributions to laboratories internationally, so previous logistics, shipping or distribution experience would be particularly useful.

You will also support customers, manage administrative systems, coordinate meetings and events, maintain accurate records and assist with quality management activities.

There will be a one-month handover period with the current postholder to help you settle into the role.

Key Responsibilities
- Support the planning and coordination of sample distributions to laboratories worldwide
- Organise shipping, packing and courier arrangements
- Communicate with customers, suppliers, agents and other external stakeholders
- Monitor customer support tickets and respond to or delegate queries appropriately
- Maintain customer accounts, registrations and participation records
- Liaise with suppliers and raise purchase orders where required
- Support stock control and general office operations
- Assist with sample packing and data loading
- Support document control, audits and non-conformance activities within the Quality Management System
- Take accurate meeting minutes when required
- Help improve administrative processes and systems
- Manage your own workload and priorities while working closely with the Operations Manager

About You

We are looking for someone organised, reliable and comfortable managing several different tasks at the same time.

You should have:
- Previous administration, operations or logistics experience
- Strong organisational and time-management skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- Confident written and verbal communication skills
- Good customer service skills
- Strong computer literacy, including Microsoft Office
- The ability to maintain accurate records and work with data
- A proactive approach to solving problems and improving processes
- The confidence to communicate with customers, suppliers and colleagues at all levels

Experience involving logistics, shipping, couriers, distributions or stock control would be particularly advantageous.

Experience within healthcare, laboratories, life sciences, quality management or another regulated environment would be beneficial but is not essential.

Why Join?
- Salary of 25,000 - 28,000
- Excellent benefits package, including a generous NHS-matched pension scheme
- Hybrid working with 4 days in the Manchester office and 1 day from home each week
- One-month handover with the current postholder
- Excellent staff retention and a stable working environment
- Supportive and collaborative team culture
- Varied role combining administration, operations, logistics and customer support

title: Care Navigator Receptionist
description: We are looking for a friendly, organised and proactive Care Navigator Receptionist & Administrator to join our busy and supportive team at Orchard Medical Centre. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, thrives in a fast-paced environment and takes pride in delivering excellent customer service. As the first point of contact for our patients, you will play a vital role in ensuring they receive the right support and are directed to the most appropriate healthcare professional or service. You will provide a professional and welcoming experience whether interacting with patients face to face, over the telephone or through digital channels. We are seeking someone with excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to remain calm and compassionate when dealing with a wide range of patient needs. In return, you will become part of a dedicated team committed to providing high quality patient care, with opportunities for ongoing development and training. If you are motivated, reliable and passionate about making a difference within primary care, we would love to hear from you. The successful candidate will provide reception, care navigation and administrative support to ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the practice. Duties include managing patient enquiries, coordinating appointments, processing prescriptions, handling correspondence, maintaining accurate patient records and supporting clinicians and colleagues with a variety of administrative tasks. You will communicate with patients through multiple channels, signpost them to appropriate services, process referrals and documentation, and ensure information is recorded accurately and confidentially. The role requires excellent organisational skills, confidence using computer systems and the ability to prioritise a varied workload while maintaining a high standard of customer service. You will also contribute to maintaining a safe, welcoming and efficient environment for patients and staff, working closely with the wider practice team to support the delivery of high-quality healthcare services. To provide a high-quality, professional reception and administrative service to patients, clinicians, colleagues and other healthcare professionals. As a key member of the practice team, you will act as the first point of contact for patients and ensure all enquiries are handled efficiently, courteously and in accordance with practice procedures. The successful candidate will receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the most appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective manner. The post holder will provide general assistance to the practice team and maintain a positive and professional image of the practice when interacting with patients, visitors and external agencies. Reception Duties Welcome and assist patients and visitors attending the practice. Manage appointment bookings, amendments and cancellations in line with practice protocols. Support care navigation by directing patients to the most appropriate clinician or service. Process urgent appointment requests and home visit requests in accordance with practice procedures. Maintain accurate and up-to-date appointment systems. Respond to patient enquiries in person, by telephone, email and other digital communication channels. Register new patients and temporary residents and explain practice procedures. Process payments for private services and issue receipts where required. Ensure patient samples are forwarded to the appropriate department or member of staff. Maintain tidy and welcoming reception and waiting areas. Ensure information leaflets and patient resources are replenished as required. Undertake opening and closing procedures and support the security of the premises. Maintain electronic and manual filing systems. Administrative Duties Work in accordance with practice policies, procedures and protocols. Process repeat prescription requests accurately and efficiently. Respond to patient enquiries received through the practice website. Process incoming electronic correspondence from hospitals and external organisations. Scan and accurately file patient correspondence within electronic records. Complete administrative tasks requested by clinicians and management. Type referral letters and process electronic referrals as required. Contact patients regarding appointments, test results and other healthcare-related matters. Support registration of new patients and updates to patient demographic information. Ensure all correspondence, reports and results are filed within the correct patient record. Use care navigation principles to direct patients to the most appropriate service. Provide a sensitive and supportive service in response to patients' needs. Maintain strict patient confidentiality at all times. Support clinicians and the wider practice team as required. Act as a chaperone when necessary and appropriately trained. Ensure clinical and administrative areas remain well stocked and organised. Assist in maintaining a safe, secure and clean working environment. Undertake other reasonable duties as requested by the Practice Manager or clinical team. The post holder will have access to confidential information relating to patients, carers, staff and the business of the practice. All information must be treated as strictly confidential and handled in accordance with practice policies, data protection legislation and professional standards. The post holder will be expected to maintain a good understanding of safeguarding responsibilities, identify concerns and follow appropriate procedures for raising and referring safeguarding issues relating to children and adults. The post holder will contribute to maintaining a safe working environment by complying with practice health and safety procedures, infection prevention and control guidance, and by reporting potential risks and hazards promptly. The post holder will support and promote equality, diversity and inclusion, treating patients, carers and colleagues with dignity, respect and fairness at all times. The post holder will participate in training and performance reviews, maintain professional knowledge and skills, and contribute to continuous service improvement within the practice. The post holder will work collaboratively with colleagues and external agencies, communicate effectively with patients and healthcare professionals, and contribute positively to the performance and development of the practice team.

title: GP Receptionist

Previous experience as a GP receptionist or in a similar medical setting preferred Basic IT skills, with experience using EMIS Web preferred The role involves a blend of administrative and front-line patient support duties within a General Practice (GP) setting. Key responsibilities include: Patient Records Management: Summarising and maintaining accurate and up-to-date patient records. Registration: Handling new patient registrations KPI Monitoring: Supporting the achievement of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), including QOF (Quality and Outcomes Framework) and Local and Direct Enhanced Service (LES and DES) targets. Patient Interaction: Managing high volumes of incoming patient calls, particularly during busy morning hours, providing support, information, and booking appointments. Prescription Requests: Processing repeat prescription requests in a timely and accurate manner. Document Management: Scanning, filing, read-coding and uploading clinical and administrative documents to patient records. To be responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception and administrative duties and the provision of general support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties include, greeting, and directing patients, patient registration, booking appointments, processing of information (electronic and hard copy) and assisting patients as required. To act as the central point of contact for patients, the distribution of information, messages, and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with multidisciplinary team members and external agencies such as secondary care and community service provider Job responsibilities (including but not limited to) : Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system Process triage and telephone requests for appointments. Book all nursing appointments. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately. Signpost patients to the correct service when care navigating. Booking appointments for patients and external agencies as required Process incoming and outgoing emails. Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies Process repeats prescriptions, ensuring they are processed accurately and efficiently. Photocopy documentation as required. File and store records as required. Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as required. Input data into the patients healthcare records as necessary. Scanning of patient related documentation and attaching scanned documents to patients healthcare records. Accept payment for private medical work. Manage all queries (including administrative queries) as necessary in an efficient manner. Accept deliveries from couriers. Ensure the pathology samples are collected. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested. Confidentiality: In the course of seeking treatment, patients entrust us with, or allow us to gather, sensitive information in relation to their health and other matters. They do so in confidence and have the right to expect that staff will respect their privacy and act appropriately. In the performance of the duties outlined in this job description, the post-holder may have access to confidential information relating to patients and their carers, practice staff and other healthcare workers. They may also have access to information relating to the practice as a business organisation. All such information from any source is to be regarded as strictly confidential. Information relating to patients, carers, colleagues, other healthcare workers or the business of the practice may only be divulged to authorised persons in accordance with the practice policies and procedures relating to confidentiality and the protection of personal and sensitive data.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Boothstown Medical Centre is looking for a friendly, professional and enthusiastic Medical Receptionist to join our busy and supportive team. As the first point of contact for patients, you will play a vital role in delivering excellent customer service, handling enquiries, managing appointments, processing information accurately and supporting the day-to-day running of the practice. We are seeking someone with excellent communication and organisational skills, a positive attitude, and a genuine commitment to providing high-quality patient care. Previous receptionist or customer service experience is desirable, although full training will be provided. At Boothstown Medical Centre, we pride ourselves on delivering compassionate, patient-centred care within a welcoming and forward-thinking practice. We have a strong team culture where every member of staff is valued and supported, and we are committed to staff wellbeing, professional development and continuous improvement. This is an excellent opportunity to join a friendly and dedicated team making a real difference to the local community every day. If you are organised, approachable and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we would love to hear from you. Well developed oral and written skills computer literate experience of working with the public ability to prioritise work ability to work under pressure excellent communication skills ability to work as part of a team flexible to cover staff annual leave and sickness ability to use own judgement, resourcefulness & common sense willingness to undertake training knowledge of medical terminology preferred but not essential previous experience of working in an General Practice is preferred although training will be provided to a suitable candidate The post holder will be the first point of contact for patients and visitors to the practice, providing a professional, welcoming and efficient reception service. They will be responsible for assisting patients in accessing the appropriate healthcare professional or service, responding to enquiries, and supporting the smooth day-to-day operation of the practice. The successful candidate will work closely with the wider practice team to deliver high standards of customer service, maintain accurate patient records, and contribute to a positive patient experience. They will represent the practice in a courteous, compassionate and professional manner, both face-to-face and over the telephone. Develop and maintain a thorough knowledge of practice procedures and services. Work in accordance with practice policies, protocols and confidentiality requirements. Undertake routine administrative tasks, including photocopying, scanning and document management. Open, process and distribute incoming post as appropriate. Liaise effectively with hospitals, community services and other healthcare professionals. Register new patients and ensure accurate completion of registration documentation. Support the wider practice team with general administrative duties as required. Welcome and assist patients and visitors attending the practice. Respond to patient enquiries promptly, efficiently and sensitively. Manage patient interactions at the reception desk while maintaining confidentiality at all times. Issue completed repeat prescriptions in accordance with practice procedures, ensuring patient details are verified. Provide cover across all reception workstations as required. Prepare pathology specimens and arrange collection by the designated courier. Distribute internal correspondence and documentation. Process patient appointment requests via telephone, online systems and face-to-face enquiries. Book, amend and cancel appointments in accordance with practice protocols. Manage requests for home visits and ensure they are directed appropriately. Record and process telephone consultation requests accurately within the clinical system. Signpost patients to the most appropriate service or healthcare professional. Register new patients and maintain accurate electronic patient records. Process changes to patient demographic information in a timely manner. Manage repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice policies. Scan, file and code clinical correspondence using the practice document management system. Accurately enter clinical and non-clinical data onto patient records. Update patient information, including smoking status, weight and other Quality and Outcomes Framework (QOF) data. Act upon relevant alerts and notifications within the clinical system. Record patient contacts and communications accurately. Complete patient details on pathology request forms as required. Answer incoming telephone calls promptly and professionally. Deal with enquiries effectively and courteously, taking accurate messages when required. Direct calls to the appropriate member of staff or service. Maintain a high standard of customer care in all telephone interactions. Contribute to maintaining a safe, secure and welcoming environment for patients, staff and visitors. Ensure reception and communal areas are kept tidy and presentable. Follow practice procedures relating to opening, closing and security of the premises, including alarms, doors and windows. Participate in mandatory training and practice meetings as required. Undertake any other duties appropriate to the post as requested by the Practice Manager or Assistant Practice Manager. This role requires excellent communication, organisational and customer service skills, together with the ability to work effectively within a busy multidisciplinary team whilst maintaining patient confidentiality at all times.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking for the right candidate to join as Medical Receptionist in our team. This is a part time position for 25 hours over Monday to Friday, shifts are between 8:00-13:00 in the mornings and 13:30-18:30 for afternoon shifts this is accommodated according the needs of the practice. Also there is a requirement to work overtime on Saturday or Sunday once a month minimum. Greet patients and visitors to the practice. Answering incoming telephone calls, ensuring calls are documented (where required) and redirected accordingly. Book, amend and cancel patient appointment in line with practice appointments procedures ensuing optimum efficiency of the appointment system. Deal with patient queries which may include calling hospital for copy of letters, lab reports or related. Ensure all tasks sent by GPs and admin staff are dealt on timely basis Ensure clinical rooms, reception and waiting areas are kept neat and tidy and also equipped with hand towels. Keep up to date with mandatory trainings. Re-stocking of information leaflets or any other relevant information as appropriate Check emails on a daily basis. Also regularly check practice general emails. Work safely at all times in accordance with GDPR Legislative requirements and Practice Policy and Procedures.
